blocks.content: Follow these steps before and after performing service on the printer to prevent damage to the printer and ensure that the repair was successful.
Follow these steps before performing any type of service on the printer.

WARNING! Turn the printer off, wait five seconds, and then remove the power cord before attempting to service the printer. If this warning is not followed, severe injury can result as well as damage to the printer. The power must be on for certain functional checks during troubleshooting. However, the power cord must be disconnected during parts removal. AC voltage is still present inside the printer when the power switch is in the off position. The power cord must be disconnected before servicing the printer.
Follow these steps after performing service on the printer.
Ensure that the print quality is acceptable after performing printer repairs.
